title: Sad Chibi Character with Umbrella
coreRelationships: The chibi character is the dominant central figure, occupying most of the vertical space.
The purple umbrella provides a strong color accent and frames the character's head.
The blurred city background creates a sense of depth and context, contrasting with the sharp character.
The floating heart emojis add thematic elements of emotion and vulnerability.
The character's expression and posture convey a sense of sadness or contemplation.
reuseFormula: Generate a 3D chibi character with dark skin, dreadlocks, and a sad expression. Dress the character in a purple puffer jacket and have them hold a purple umbrella. Place the character centrally against a blurred, neon-lit city background. Add floating pink and blue heart emojis, some broken, around the character. Integrate custom-lettered text 'Melina' and 'Tracey' as if tattooed on the character's face, using a thin, black, informal script with small heart and cross symbols.
